name: Object Storage
description: Generic object storage browser for Alibaba Cloud OSS and S3-compatible services (MinIO, AWS S3, R2, COS, OBS, B2...). Server-side pagination with list virtualization, chunked upload, presigned URL sharing, file preview (Office / 3D / HTML / Markdown), and multi-select batch delete / download.

versions.releaseNotes: First generic release: StorageDriver abstraction (Aliyun OSS native + S3-compatible via minio-go), large-directory pagination, chunked upload, presigned sharing, file preview (image/video/audio/pdf/text/code/markdown), multi-select batch delete/download.

Fix public-read ACL: objects can now be reverted to private (previously stuck public because the Aliyun SDK does not expose object-level Grants, so the plugin now probes anonymous accessibility instead). Added a public-status badge and a toolbar toggle to scan and mark public-read objects. Connection presets for Alibaba Cloud OSS, Tencent COS, Huawei OBS, AWS S3, MinIO, Cloudflare R2, Wasabi and Backblaze B2.

Generic object storage browser for Alibaba Cloud OSS and S3-compatible services (MinIO, R2, COS...). Driver abstraction, large-directory pagination, chunked upload, presigned sharing, file preview, multi-select batch delete/download.

Disclaimer: this is an independent third-party plugin. It is not affiliated with, endorsed, authorized or sponsored by any of the storage vendors named above; vendor and service names are used solely to indicate protocol compatibility and remain the property of their respective owners. Credentials are used only between your machine and your own storage service and are never sent to third parties; the Secret is stored in plaintext on this machine only if you explicitly opt in. Presigned links grant access to anyone holding them until they expire.
